purpose: Unified runtime-ready contract for interactive locomotive schemes. It is compatible with the existing TechnicalHotspot model and the Ermak hotspot/flow approach, while keeping source-image overlays optional.

renderModes.SEMANTIC_CANVAS: Render nodes and directed links from the data itself. Hotspot coordinates are semantic layout coordinates and are not claimed to match a scanned drawing.
renderModes.SOURCE_OVERLAY: Optional future mode. Requires a verified source image plus independently checked image-space hotspot coordinates.

flowContract.rule: Every from/to endpoint must be represented by a hotspot in the same effective view.

navigationContract.equipmentToScheme: derive reverse index from all hotspot layers
navigationContract.diagnosticToScheme: join diagnostic equipment refs to hotspot equipmentId; an explicit preferredSchemeId may override ranking
navigationContract.equipmentCardBackToScheme: reverse index sorted by active profile and scheme priority
navigationContract.designationSearch: resolve aliases/designations to equipmentId, then focus all matching hotspots
navigationContract.profileSelection: profile gate is mandatory before showing variant-only views or hotspots

overlayBecomesReadyWhen: source image is identified and versioned
hotspots are mapped in the image coordinate system
